subject: glb-fixture-byte-layouts
thesis: Hugging Face's own docs confirm that a dataset repository holds data files plus a README.md card and that CSV is a supported format, so the intended two-file layout (data.csv and README.md) matches the documented convention; but no source I read shows glb-fixture-byte-layouts published, so the live URL, file list and contents remain unverified.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: CSV is among the formats supported in Hugging Face dataset repositories.

claims.text: The upload guide says a README.md in a repository serves as the dataset card, and that a repository is made public or private by choice.
claims.quote: Click on Create Dataset Card to create a Dataset card. This button creates a README.md file in your repository.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The Hub upload guide states text file extensions are not tracked by Git LFS by default and files greater than 10MB will not be committed and uploaded.
claims.quote: Text file extensions are not tracked by Git LFS by default, and if they’re greater than 10MB, they will not be committed and uploaded.

claims.quote: Dataset repositories offer features such as: Free dataset hosting Dataset versioning Commit history and diffs Metadata for discoverability Dataset cards for documentation, licensing, limitations, etc.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The huggingface_hub upload guide shows upload_file() requiring a local path, a path in the repository and a repo_id.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: huggingface/datasets has 25 raw commits in the last 30 days and its latest real commit is efc8247, on 2026-11-10.

claims.label: DERIVED
claims.text: The intended dataset layout of one data file plus one README.md card conforms to the file set Hugging Face documents for a dataset repository.
claims.math: c1 says the only files to upload are the data files and the dataset card README.md; the plan is out/data.csv as data.csv plus out/README.md as README.md, which is one data file plus one card, so it matches the documented set.
